t: r/Tools on Reddit: Getting my first tool set. Pretty sure it will be a Kobalt set from Lowe's. I'd love to hear suggestions for any other tools you think I should add to the bag. Details in the description.
Will Lowes Replace Kobalt Tools with Craftsman Products?
s: **fun game for hardcore lowe’s tool shoppers: walk the tool department and see if you can count all the items now re-badged/branded as Craftsman that were originally other SBD brands: Porter Cable (looks like some of the cordless tools), Stanley (tape measures, miter boxes, some tool storage, irwin (I suspect mainly bits here, but also maybe some hand tools..) at the end of the day, it looks like 65-70% of the Craftsman stuff is replacing or is a direct rebrand of existing SBD tools. Where things have changed is Kobalt sockets, ratchets and wrenches, Kobalt tool chests, Kobalt hand tools, and Kobalt drill bits and impact bits have all considerably shrunk.
